name: blob-location
sql: SELECT p.pack_hash,b.byte_offset,b.encoded_length FROM editorial_blobs b JOIN editorial_blob_packs p ON p.id=b.pack_id WHERE b.hash=?

plan.detail: SEARCH p USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

name: pack-selection
sql: SELECT b.* FROM editorial_blobs b WHERE b.pack_id IS NULL ORDER BY b.hash LIMIT ?

name: source-history
sql: SELECT r.candidate_id,r.revision FROM content_candidates c JOIN content_candidate_revisions r ON r.candidate_id=c.id WHERE c.source_id=? AND r.observed_at>=?

plan.detail: SEARCH c USING COVERING INDEX candidates_source_time (source_id=?)
